message:
Add Options screen, setup scripts for Windows/Linux, update code guide

Options screen (OPTIONS on the title screen):
- settings.py: player-tunable settings with safe ranges; changes are written
  into config and saved to settings.json (ignored by git). Broken or
  hand-edited files are ignored/clamped, never crash the game.
- options_menu.py: tabs, sliders, switches, help line, live mouth score and
  head-tilt readout, Reset to defaults. ui.py: Slider and Toggle widgets.
- limb_poses and AngleSmoother read config when used so changes apply live.

Python environment:
- setup.bat/setup.ps1 (Windows) and setup.sh (Linux) create .venv, install
  CUDA or CPU PyTorch, the pinned requirements, optional TensorRT, and
  download the models (download_models.py). run.bat / run.sh start the game.
- requirements pinned; both OpenCV packages pinned to the same version.
- Linux: font fallbacks (config.FONT_*), emoji skipped when no emoji font,
  checks for python3-venv, libGL and webcam permission; .gitattributes.
- The TensorRT engine is only used when the tensorrt package is installed.

Docs: tools/docs rebuilds the PDF; guide updated with the Options screen,
settings, the environment and the new files (82 pages).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add explanatory code comments and a PDF code guide

- Comments throughout the code explaining what each block does and why
  (units, conventions, the maths). Code is unchanged: the parsed code of
  every file is identical apart from comments and docstrings.
- docs/All_For_One_Code_Guide.pdf: 66-page guide covering the architecture,
  frame flow, physics, vision pipeline, every file block by block with its
  full source, a settings reference, and how the pose/face models work.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add cave map with map selection, fix escaping through the map top

- New Cave map (assets/*-cave.png) at 1.5x scale, with its start point at
  the bottom-left tunnel entrance and the flag on the top-right grass.
- maps.py: maps listed in config.MAPS are scaled to a common height so the
  character, flag, view and physics match on every map; per-map "scale".
- Menu: "Choose a map" page with map pictures after the player count.
- Best times are kept per map and player count; HUD shows the map name.
- Flag search skips a solid border along the map's top edge.
- Fix: above the map, solid top-row columns now continue as rock that gets
  deeper going up, so a character pushed through the cave's thin top border
  is pushed back down instead of flying upward forever.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Stop feet from sinking into rock while feet are glued

While a foot is glued the body is pinned, so legs could push feet deep
into the terrain (up to ~30 px before the glue tore off).
- A physics step that pushes a moving leg's own foot into the rock is
  redone with that leg held still, so the leg stops at the surface.
- Glued feet are capped by the solver at STICKY_SINK (6 px) so another
  leg can't shove them in either; free feet get LEG_BLOCK_TOLERANCE (3 px).
Jumping and walking without sticky feet are unchanged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

All For One: body-controlled co-op climbing game

Pygame climbing game where 1-4 players control a four-legged character
with their arms (YOLO pose) and make its feet sticky by opening their
mouths (MediaPipe face landmarks). Includes menu, 1-player test screen,
single-window layout with camera preview, fullscreen, flag goal with
timer, and GPU/TensorRT pose inference.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
